county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have exits that are accessible at all times.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Notify each resident of certain balances and convey resident funds upon discharge, eviction, or death.
Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
